name: retail-reason
description: Retail Reason — connected expert service for Walmart suppliers, Sam's Club suppliers, and Marketplace sellers. Ask expert questions about Walmart 1P supplier operations, Walmart supplier-facing data and analytics (Scintilla), Marketplace 3P selling, and the Supplier One portal; pitfall-check draft deliverables before they ship; look up Walmart terms; convert Walmart fiscal-calendar dates. Answers come from the hosted Retail Reason service and require a user-bound access key (see codex/README.md for the MCP server setup).
